description.value: Bodega 88 is an Upper West Side sports bar at 573 Columbus Ave, New York, NY 10024. It invites guests to join us for Happy Hour Drinks from 11 am - 7 pm. Specials cover beer, sangria and classic mojitos, which makes it an easy casual stop. Restaurantji shows 4.3 262 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “The guacamole is fresh and served with both tortilla and plantain chips”; “Happy Hour is the time to go”.
